name: API Studio
description: An HTTP client for building, sending and testing API requests: a request editor with params, body, headers and auth, {{variables}} with their values under the pointer, and a response viewer with pretty bodies, headers, cookies and a timing waterfall. Requests go out through the curl program, without a shell, their contents on its standard input.

endue.api-studio.curl.description: The curl program requests go through: a path, or empty for curl on the desk's PATH (then where it is usually installed).

endue.api-studio.history.description: Keep the last requests sent in the History panel.
